what: Multi-line text starts pale gray (text color at 20%), and as you scroll the darker text color fills in left→right starting from the first line — one line must fill before the next begins. It starts when the element’s top edge has risen 15% from the bottom of the screen and ends at 60%. Scrolling back up drains it again · with end: bottom top it fills from when the element touches the screen bottom until it leaves the top, and with once: 1 it stays filled once complete (studio concept sentence, power1.out per line)

options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to fill (one inline-block or block line each)
options.from: Start: ratio of the element’s top edge risen from the bottom of the screen, default .15
options.to: End ratio, default .6 — above 1 the element keeps filling after it has passed above the screen
options.--fx-from / --fx-to: Light and dark shades (default 20% of text color · text color)
options.end: ScrollTrigger end (e.g. "bottom top") — if given, instead of from · to it fills from ‹element top at screen bottom› to this end
options.ease: A curve that fills within one line, default straight (power1.out — GSAP’s default curve for the original’s timeline line tweens)
options.once: If 1, once full it does not drop out even if the trigger is released and scrolled back
